source.derivation: Ixy = sqrt(((I1-I2)/2)^2 - ((Ix-Iy)/2)^2) with I2 = Ix+Iy-I1; recovers 3e-6 m^4
0.2 x 0.1 rectangle polygon: A = 0.02, Ix = bh^3/12 = 1.66667e-5, Zx = bh^2/4 = 5e-4, Zy = hb^2/4 = 0.1·0.04/4 = 1e-3, shape_y = 1.5 (rectangle landmark; agrees with the rectangle calculator)

Right triangle b=0.2, h=0.1: A = 0.01; xbar = b/3 = 0.0666667; Ix = bh^3/36 = 5.55556e-6; Ixy = -b^2 h^2/72 = -5.55556e-6; Zx: equal-area axis at c = h(1-1/sqrt2) = 0.0292893, Q_above = b(h-c)^3/(6h) = 1.17851e-4, Zx = 2Q - A(ybar-c) = 1.95262e-4; shape_x = 2.34315 (triangle landmark). For the vertical axis: c = b(1-1/sqrt2) = 0.0585786, Q_above = hb^2/(12·sqrt2) = 2.35702e-4, Zy = 2Q - A(xbar-c) = 4.71405e-4 - 8.08803e-5 = 3.90524e-4; shape_y = 2.34315 (same triangle landmark)

Two 0.1x0.1 squares at (0.05,0.05) and (0.15,0.15): A = 0.02, centroid (0.1,0.1); Ix = 2(0.1·0.001/12) + 2·0.01·0.0025 = 6.66667e-5; Ixy = 2·0.01·0.0025 = 5e-5; equal-area axis between the squares at c=0.1, Zx = 2·0.01·0.05 = 1e-3; I1 = Ix + |Ixy| = 1.16667e-4; with Ix = Iy and Ixy > 0, theta_p = 1/2 atan2(-2·Ixy, 0) = -45 deg (I1 axis across the +45-deg diagonal pair)
Same 0.2 × 0.1 m rectangle translated to x = 1 m: plastic moduli are translation-invariant, Zx = b h²/4 = 0.2·0.01/4 = 5e-4, Zy = h b²/4 = 0.1·0.04/4 = 1e-3 m³

Flange-down tee: flange 100×10 mm (A 1e-3), web 10×50 mm (A 5e-4), total 1.5e-3. Equal-area axis in the flange at y = 7.5 mm. Zx = 7.5e-4·3.75e-3 + 2.5e-4·1.25e-3 + 5e-4·(35 − 7.5)e-3 = 2.8125e-6 + 3.125e-7 + 1.375e-5 = 1.6875e-5. Zy (symmetric about x = 0) = 2·(5e-4·0.025) + 2·(2.5e-4·0.0025) = 2.5e-5 + 1.25e-6 = 2.625e-5 m³. Also matched a 1600² raster integration.
